capa.addTitle: Add a corrective or preventive action
capa.addDescription: Its owner records it as done; quality assurance then checks that it worked.
capa.descriptionHint: Such as: retrain staff on SOP-004, recalibrate the scale, replace the seal.
capa.completeHint: Kept with the incident for inspection.
capa.verifyHint: Such as: no recurrence in 30 days, scale within tolerance.
